concurrent jobs: tempts will fail until the rate limit resets. Each request to delete caches either by key or by ID counts towards this limit. Workflow file size Each workflow file in the .github/workflows directory must be 500 KB or smaller to trigger a run. To reduce the size of a workflow file, move shared logic into a reusable workflow or a composite action. See Reuse workflows or Creating a composite action . Job concurrency limits for GitHub-hosted runners GitHub Support can increase job concurrency limits for GitHub Actions. To request an increase, submit a support ticket.
